The '''Salvage bandits''' were a group of [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] criminals and salvagers that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were led by [[Uruli|Boss Uruli]]. One of their base of operations was the [[Salvage Bandit Camp]] in the south-eastern part of the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]].<ref name="SWG:TJGD" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Salvage Bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TJGD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Salvage Bandits were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TJGD" />
